item.title: Review? Young Frances - Hartley Lin
item.description: Trying to understand what Young Frances by Hartley Lin is saying. And maybe find where I want to go along the way. Her friendship is imperfect. It seems to suck. But they seem to make amends. Her job seems like it is nothing but soul destroying. The people seem awful. The people who stay for years seem like they sold something of themselves to stay on. Yet Frances takes the promotion.
